stem: Raul wants to add a supporting sentence to the second paragraph (sentences 6-13). Which sentence should be added after sentence 8?

options.label: A
options.text: Most of the fish species in Big Bend are the size of minnows, but there are also large catfish.

options.label: B
options.text: Nearly a quarter of the animal species native to North America can be found in Big Bend.

options.label: C
options.text: If actions are not soon taken, many endangered species will be lost forever.

options.label: D
options.text: Tropical rain forests, which are not found in North America, would have more animal species.
